goal: Epic 5733 slice 02, ADO Story #5835 - the ask. The Usage Data dialog arrives unprompted at a sensible moment, once per browser, and states honestly whether it will return before the reader chooses. Slice 01c shipped a real product event to a population consisting of the dogfood instance and whoever went hunting for a footer icon; this is the slice that turns that pipe from a demonstrated mechanism into a measurement. It also gives PruneStaleAsync its first production caller, because this is the slice that makes unbounded consent-row growth real: every browser shown the dialog writes a row, refusals included. DISTILL is committed: 46 scenarios pend behind [Ignore] and describe.skip, and four assertions it was structurally unable to author are named in the feature delta's 'owed in DELIVER' table. Every step below names the pending cases it un-skips and the owed cases it authors.

phases.name: Slice 02 backend - derive whether to ask, remember having asked, and stop the table growing

steps.name: mayAsk: the server weighs install age, the switch and the decision, and answers one boolean
authors: A Community refusal becomes due again after ~3 months (owed: needs the injected TimeProvider and the field this step adds)
A Premium refusal never becomes due again, at any elapsed time
steps.notes: UsageDataState gains MayAsk. The master-switch reader currently lives as a private static on UsageDataGate with its key as a private const; two copies of 'a missing row means on' is one piece of knowledge in two places, so extract it rather than duplicate. AskAfterInstallDays and ReAskAfterDays join UsageDataConfiguration. Shared contract: UsageDataState is consumed by the frontend - grep callers and extend the test factory first.

steps.name: The asked endpoint: a browser that was shown the dialog says so, and only for itself
steps.notes: Sets AskedAt, which already exists on the entity - 01c added the column ahead of this slice so it would not cost a migration on every supported database. A conditional write through an affected-row count, like TryRevokeAsync, and the count is dropped for the same non-oracular reason. Rate-limited under UsageDataConsentPolicy. UsageDataController is a shared contract.

steps.name: Pruning, with the re-ask window as a hard floor
authors: Prune leaves a declined row alone until its re-ask date has passed
Prune removes a granted row long unseen
Prune removes a declined row whose re-ask date has passed and which stopped visiting
steps.notes: PruneStaleAsync grows a second concept per DT-21. Its two existing integration tests (RemovesWhatHasAgedOut, LeavesARowSittingExactlyOnTheThreshold) are revisited, not merely added to. A BackgroundService with a pull-able trigger, following UsageDataForwardingService.SendWhatIsWaitingAsync - the test host runs no background work, so a test needs to ask for the pass at a moment it chooses.

phases.name: Slice 02 browser - remember, coordinate, decide, and open

steps.name: The two things the browser remembers: that it was asked, and who holds the session
steps.notes: Both wrap storage that throws rather than returning null in private windows. Reading must not write - that is the basis on which anything may be stored without asking first.

steps.name: The decision, and the sentence that has to agree with it
steps.notes: The marker is consulted only for a browser with no recorded decision. For one that has decided, the server owns the cadence - otherwise a marker left over from the first ask would silence the three-month re-ask it was never about.

steps.name: The dialog arrives without being asked for, and says whether it will return
steps.notes: UsageDataService gains acknowledgeAsked; the provider carries mayAsk; UsageDataDialog takes willAskAgain and renders cadenceSentence; Footer passes it; App.tsx mounts UsageDataAsk. This is the step that removes the RED scaffold's throw, so it is also the step where an unmounted component becomes a mounted one.

steps.name: The survey nudge learns it is no longer alone
steps.notes: Claims the slot when it appears; stands down when something else holds it; claims nothing when it was never going to appear. A shipped, green component - the change is additive and its existing tests must stay green untouched.

phases.name: Slice 02 end to end - suppressed by default, proven once

steps.name: The fixture stops the modal eating every spec, and one skeleton proves it still appears
steps.notes: LighthouseFixture seeds the DT-14 marker through context.addInitScript. One spec clears it, backdates Install:Timestamp, and asserts the unprompted open plus the cadence sentence. Through a page object. Run locally before it is committed - never commit an unrun spec or locator.

out_of_scope: The admin switch itself (#5836, slice 03). This slice honours it if the row exists and treats its absence as may-ask.
Stryker mutation testing, ADO transitions and the push - held for the maintainer's manual review.
